Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"},"createdAt":"2026-10-08T03:40:52.338531Z","finishedAt":"2026-10-08T03:42:57.165703Z","id":"dep-db3h1h3l550s73agjnh0","startedAt":"2026-10-08T03:40:52.315909Z","status":"live","trigger":"new_commit","updatedAt":"2026-10-08T03:43:27.578989Z"},{"commit":{"createdAt":"2026-10-08T02:02:24Z","id":"293546e807294dc0812f390b240a4cfb68e86cd0","message":"Let students search and filter schools by region, and tidy what they read there

A student looking for Eastern Europe found nothing: the search only matched
text, so "東歐", "Europe" and "Poland" returned no school, and the country list
was 41 names in no useful order. The data was complete (all 31 NTPU schools in
those nine countries are in it); the page just could not be asked for a region.

- regions.js maps every country to a region (東歐／中歐, 西歐, 東亞 ...) with
  everyday words and English names. The school search gets a 地區 drop-down
  (also in the address as ?region=), the country drop-down is grouped by
  region, and the search box matches region words and English country names.
- The five Czech schools no longer start with a stray "Republic " (the country
  prefix pattern left it behind); renamed in the parser and the bundled data.
- The quota filter says 本期開放 instead of a hard-coded 115 學年度, and a
  school with an agreement but no places this period says so in one sentence.
- The 用戶評價 page invites people who have been on exchange (進修部, 碩專,
  less-travelled regions) to share how they applied.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"},"createdAt":"2026-10-08T02:12:41.783539Z","finishedAt":"2026-10-08T02:14:44.584478Z","id":"dep-db3fo6ff3r2c73ft69d0","startedAt":"2026-10-08T02:12:41.760715Z","status":"deactivated","trigger":"new_commit","updatedAt":"2026-10-08T03:42:57.164906Z"},{"commit":{"createdAt":"2026-10-07T11:40:06Z","id":"f741d540f546d6ddbbf3174c9a34b5ef103c8816","message":"Let /health answer HEAD so a free uptime monitor can keep the site awake

Render's free host sleeps after 15 minutes without traffic and the first visitor then waits about a
minute on Render's own page. A free monitor that asks /health every five minutes prevents that, but
those monitors ask with HEAD by default and /health refused it with 405, which they report as "down".
HEAD now answers 200 without reading anything; the published API (the frozen OpenAPI contract) and the
GET answer are unchanged, and pings were already left out of the statistics.

The deploy guide gets the setup steps and the usage arithmetic (750 free hours per workspace a month;
one service awake all month is 744 hours, so it fits only if it is the workspace's only free service).
